description: This file defines the 'FileHistory' entity class used for persisting file history records related to merchant store files, including fields such as file size, dates, and download count, with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: FileHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing the file history record with fields for tracking file details and associated metadata.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the file history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the file history record.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Returns the MerchantStore associated with this file history.

methods.name: setStore
methods.description: Sets the MerchantStore associated with this file history.

methods.name: getFilesize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: setFilesize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getDateAdded
methods.description: Returns the date the file was added, cloning the Date object for immutability.

methods.name: setDateAdded
methods.description: Sets the date the file was added, cloning the Date object for immutability.

methods.name: getDateDeleted
methods.description: Returns the date the file was deleted, cloning the Date object for immutability.

methods.name: setDateDeleted
methods.description: Sets the date the file was deleted, cloning the Date object for immutability.

methods.name: getAccountedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the file was accounted, cloning the Date object for immutability.

methods.name: setAccountedDate
methods.description: Sets the date the file was accounted, cloning the Date object for immutability.

methods.name: getDownloadCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the file has been downloaded.
